strings.name: Jean Tirole
strings.summary: Tirole moved from engineering into economics, earning his doctorate at MIT and working extensively in Toulouse. He uses game theory to analyze market power, asymmetric information and industrial regulation, collaborating with Laffont, Rochet and others on incentives and platform markets. Awarded the 2014 economics Nobel, he emphasizes regulation adapted to industry conditions and also contributes to digital-economy and public-policy debates.
